arxiv-2012-05636.title: Note on a family of surfaces with p g = q = 2 p_{g}=q=2 and K 2 = 7 K^{2}=7
arxiv-2012-05636.creator: Matteo Penegini, Roberto Pignatelli
arxiv-2012-05636.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Matteo Penegini, Roberto Pignatelli. We study a family of surfaces of general type with p g = q = 2 p_{g}=q=2 and K 2 = 7 K^{2}=7 , originally constructed by C. We provide an alternative construction of these surfaces, that allows us to describe their Albanese map and the corresponding locus ℳ \mathcal{M} in the moduli space of the surfaces of general type.

arxiv-2110-07365.title: DynoLoc : Infrastructure-free RF Tracking in Dynamic Indoor Environments
arxiv-2110-07365.creator: Md. Shaifur Rahman 1 , Ayon Chakraborty 2 , Karthikeyan Sunderasan 3 , Sampath Rangarajan 4
arxiv-2110-07365.description: Abstract Promising solutions exist today that can accurately track mobile entities indoor using visual inertial odometry in favorable visual conditions , or by leveraging fine-grained ranging (RF, ultrasonic, IR, etc.) to reference anchors . However, they are unable to directly cater to “ dynamic ” indoor environments (e.g. first responder scenarios, multi-player AR/VR gaming in everyday spaces, etc.

arxiv-2212-06433.creator: E.T.Akhmedov, K.V.Bazarov
arxiv-2212-06433.description: Abstract We consider quantum real massive scalar field in the de Sitter–Schwarzschild space-time backround. To have an analytic head way we study in detail the two-dimensional case, assuming that the situation in four dimensions will not be much different conceptually. arxiv-2403-06622.title: A Formal Modeling Language for Smart Contracts
arxiv-2403-06622.creator: Adele Veschetti, Richard Bubel, Reiner Hähnle
arxiv-2403-06622.description: Abstract Smart contracts codify real-world transactions and automatically execute the terms of the contract when predefined conditions are met. This paper proposes SmartML, a modeling language for smart contracts that is platform independent and easy to comprehend. We detail its formal semantics and type system with a focus on its role in addressing security vulnerabilities.

arxiv-2412-03551.title: SPICE: Smart Projection Interface for Cooking Enhancement
arxiv-2412-03551.creator: Vera Prohaska, Eduardo Castelló Ferrer
arxiv-2412-03551.description: Abstract Tangible User Interfaces (TUI) for human–computer interaction (HCI) provide the user with physical representations of digital information with the aim to overcome the limitations of screen-based interfaces. Although many compelling demonstrations of TUIs exist in the literature, there is a lack of research on TUIs intended for daily two-handed tasks and processes, such as cooking.

arxiv-2501-15603.title: Advancing TDFN: Precise Fixation Point Generation Using Reconstruction Differences
arxiv-2501-15603.creator: Shuguang Wang, Yuanjing Wang
arxiv-2501-15603.description: Abstract Wang and Wang 2025 proposed the Task-Driven Fixation Network (TDFN) based on the fixation mechanism, which leverages low-resolution information along with high-resolution details near fixation points to accomplish specific visual tasks. The model employs reinforcement learning to generate fixation points. However, training reinforcement learning models is challenging, particularly when aiming to generate pixel-level accurate fixation points on high-resolution images.

arxiv-2510-13962.title: Simulation budgeting for hybrid effective field theories
arxiv-2510-13962.creator: and Martin White
arxiv-2510-13962.description: Abstract In this work, we forecast the number of, and requirements on, N-body simulations needed to train hybrid effective field theory (HEFT) emulators for a range of use cases, using a hybrid of HMcode and perturbation theory as a surrogate model.

britannica-1911-sylvester-joshua.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-sylvester-joshua.description: Article 'Sylvester, Joshua' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 26), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. a Kentish clothier, was born in 1563. In his tenth year he was sent to school at Southampton, where he gained a knowledge of French. After about three years at school he appears to have been put to business, and in 1591 the title-page of his Yvry states that he was in the service of the Merchant Adventurers' Company.

pmc-11446268.title: Van der Waals integrated single-junction light-emitting diodes exceeding 10% quantum efficiency at room temperature
pmc-11446268.creator: Zhenliang Hu, Qiang Fu, Junpeng Lu, Yong Zhang, Qi Zhang, Shixuan Wang, Zhexing Duan, Yuwei Zhang, Xiaoya Liu, Qiang Pan, Guangsheng Jiang, Tong Yang, Xu Han, Yutian Yang, Tianqi Liu, Tao Tao, Wenhui Wang, Bei Zhao, Xueyong Yuan, Dongyang Wan, Yanpeng Liu, Yumeng You, Peng Zhou, Hongwei Liu, Zhenhua
pmc-11446268.description: The construction of miniaturized light-emitting diodes (LEDs) with high external quantum efficiency (EQE) at room temperature remains a challenge for on-chip optoelectronics. Here, we demonstrate microsized LEDs fabricated by a dry-transfer van der Waals (vdW) integration method using typical layered Ruddlesden-Popper perovskites (RPPs).

pmc-11690474.description: The University of Massachusetts Boston is a public research university serving approximately 16,000 students. It is the most diverse university in New England and third most diverse university in the nation. The Gerontology Department is committed to growing the size and diversity of the workforce in aging services, policy, practice, and research.

pmc-12405587.title: Non-coding RNA profiling in BRAFV600E-mutant cutaneous melanoma before and after Spry1 depletion
pmc-12405587.creator: Jessica Lamberti, Domenico Memoli, Barbara Montico, Francesco Silvestro, Roberto Guerrieri, Francesca Colizzi, Alessandro Weisz, Annamaria Salvati, Elisabetta Fratta, Giovanni Nassa
pmc-12405587.description: Cutaneous melanoma (CM), with a continuously rising incidence worldwide, represents the most aggressive type of skin cancer, and it leads to the majority of skin cancer-related deaths. Approximately 50% of CM carry the activating BRAFV600 mutation and, although BRAF inhibitors have demonstrated clinical efficacy, most patients often develop early resistance to treatment.

pmc-12466665.title: Thromboelastographic Assessment of Coagulation Profiles in Dogs with Cardiac Tumors and Their Relationship to Cardiac Function
pmc-12466665.creator: Zeki Yilmaz, Hakan Salci, Pınar Levent, Didem Algan, Tuğba Varlik, Mehmet Emre Topçu, Ryou Tanaka, Lina Hamabe
pmc-12466665.description: Simple SummaryCardiac tumors are serious conditions that can impair both cardiac function and the coagulation system, potentially leading to hemorrhagic or thrombotic complications. In this study, we examined the impact of cardiac tumors on hemostasis in dogs, aiming to elucidate the associated coagulation changes and assess cardiac structure and function.

pmc-13029214.title: Alcohol and Substance Use After Bariatric Surgery: Nutritional Risks and Clinical Implications in Long-Term Postoperative Care
pmc-13029214.creator: Martín Campuzano-Donoso, Claudia Reytor-González, Gerardo Sarno, Martha Montalvan, Luigi Barrea, Giovanna Muscogiuri, Ludovica Verde, Giuseppe Annunziata, Daniel Simancas-Racines
pmc-13029214.description: Metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS) has evolved into a highly effective neurohormonal intervention for severe obesity; however, it introduces unique long-term vulnerabilities, particularly regarding alcohol (AUD) and substance use disorders (SUD). This review synthesizes the epidemiological, pharmacokinetic, and neurobiological drivers of postoperative substance misuse.

pmc-13091929.title: Endothelial Senescence Drives Deleterious Endothelial-Adipocyte Cross-Talk in Patients With Heart Failure and Type 2 Diabetes
pmc-13091929.creator: Oliver I Brown, Katherine I Bridge, Alexander-Francisco Bruns, Cheukyau Luk, Natallia Makava, Chew W Cheng, Pradeep Wijayagoonawardana, Muzahir Tayebjee, Christopher ED Saunderson, Sam Straw, Michael Drozd, Anna Skroma, Natalie J Haywood, Hema Viswambharan, Stephe Kamalathasan, John Gierula, David J
pmc-13091929.description: Visual AbstractKey Words: cell cross-talk, endothelium, heart failure, senescence, type 2 diabetes mellitus Heart failure (HF) with reduced ejection fraction and type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) are global epidemics that frequently coexist.1, 2, 3 Despite recent advances in pharmacologic therapies, patients with both HF and T2DM (HFDM) have a prognosis worse than many malignancies.

pmc-13160438.title: KAT6A is essential for developmental control gene expression in neural stem and progenitor cells
pmc-13160438.creator: Anne K. Voss, Samantha Eccles, Johannes Wichmann, Waruni Abeysekera, Maria I. Bergamasco, Alexandra L. Garnham, Nishika Ranathunga, Yuqing Yang, Rory Bowden, Gordon K. Smyth, Tim Thomas, Wei-Hsiang Huang, Wei-Hsiang Huang, Wei-Hsiang Huang
pmc-13160438.description: Heterozygous variants in the KAT6A gene encoding the histone lysine acetyltransferase KAT6A (MOZ, MYST3) cause Arboleda-Tham syndrome, a cognitive impairment syndrome. Histone acetylation is generally associated with active gene transcription. Genetic deletion of both alleles of the Kat6a gene in mice causes developmental defects including anterior homeotic transformation, cleft palate, interrupted aortic arch and cardiac septal defects.

pmc-13219718.title: Alpha-1 antitrypsin as a new biomarker of inflammation, infection and disease severity in community-acquired pneumonia: a prospective cohort study
pmc-13219718.creator: Siqing Huang, Shuna Wei, Fang Luo, Yuanxiong Cheng
pmc-13219718.description: Alpha-1 antitrypsin (α1-AT), an acute-phase protein, demonstrates anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and immunomodulatory properties. The early detection of disease severity and pathogen in community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) is crucial for patient management. The role of α1-AT in this context has not been fully elucidated. Our study compared plasma α1-AT levels between 74 CAP patients and 86 healthy controls.

uslaw-usc-t12-s5802.title: 12 U.S.C. § 5802 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t12-s5802.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s5802.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 55 (Adjustable Interest Rate (Libor)). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter: (1) Benchmark The term “benchmark” means an index of interest rates or dividend rates that is used, in whole or in part, as the basis of or as a reference for calculating or determining any valuation, payment, or other measurement.
